summary: Vercel-readiness regression pass. Backend: 33/33 pytest passed (one flaky ReadTimeout on test_change_password_happy_and_restore in first run — passed on immediate re-run; not a regression). Direct curl verifications on preview URL: GET /api/health→200 {ok:true,service:'Bimbel AELC API'}; OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin https://example.vercel.app + ACRM POST → 200 with access-control-allow-origin echoing exact origin AND access-control-allow-credentials: true (allow_origin_regex '.*' works); POST wrong creds→401 (not 405); GET /api/auth/login→405 (expected); POST correct creds→200 with Set-Cookie access_token HttpOnly Secure SameSite=None Max-Age=28800 Partitioned. Admin seed persists across restart (login works). Vercel config coherence verified: vercel.json rewrites /api/(.*)→/api/index and SPA fallback ✓, buildCommand 'cd frontend && CI=false yarn build' ✓, outputDirectory frontend/build ✓, functions api/index.py maxDuration 30 with excludeFiles ✓. /app/api/index.py successfully imports FastAPI app (title='Bimbel AELC API'). /app/requirements.txt contains fastapi, motor, pymongo, dnspython, pydantic[email], bcrypt, PyJWT, httpx, python-dotenv (all present). critical_code_review_comments: vercel.json + api/index.py are coherent — the sys.path insertion loads backend/server.py cleanly and FastAPI app imports without side-effect DB calls (lifespan + ready_guard middleware defer index/seed until first /api request → serverless-safe).

CORS: allow_origin_regex '.*' with allow_credentials=True is verified working end-to-end — origin is echoed back (not '*'), which is what browsers require for credentialed requests. This is the correct fix for the 405 report (the 405 was because the SPA host was serving OPTIONS/POST /api/auth/login as a static route on Vercel before the rewrite; now /api/* is rewritten to the Python function).
Cookie flags on preview: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=None Max-Age=28800 Partitioned — correct for cross-site cookie in modern browsers.
server.py is still ~614 lines (carry-over) — consider modularizing routes.

/app/requirements.txt is minimal and does NOT pin emergentintegrations or emailer deps (emailer.py reads EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY lazily → 503 if missing, so Vercel deployments without that env var will fail change-password OTP send but /api/auth/login is unaffected — acceptable, but worth documenting in README).
